about: Phrases that must not come back in user-facing text. Read by tests/docs/canonical-wording.test.ts and by hanova.app's scripts/check-sync.sh (fetched from main). pattern: a regex that means the same in JS and in Perl with (?a); flags: "i" or "". scope: all = every surface; pages = the setup page and the NOVA page only. quotedOk: text inside “ ” (an on-screen label) doesn't count. sha256 + words: every lower-case run of words-matches, split on - and _, rejoined with - (each sub-run), is hashed and compared. Each line is matched together with its neighbours, so a phrase wrapped across lines still counts. Allowed exceptions live next to each reader, never here.
